settings.title: “Now that’s a flag.”
settings.content: Bought it for my dad — 26 years in the Marine Corps. He’s a man of few words. He hung it over the fireplace the same day and just said, “Now that’s a flag.”

settings.title: Not the big-box stuff
settings.content: I was worried it’d look like the printed stuff at the big-box stores. Then I picked it up. It’s heavy, the eagle detail is unreal, and you can see where it was worked by hand.

settings.title: Third one I’ve ordered

settings.question: Is it really handmade in the USA?
settings.answer: Yes — every single carving is cut, burned, sealed, and signed by our founder, a retired U.S. Army veteran, in his American workshop. Nothing is imported, outsourced, or printed. That’s the whole point of this company.

settings.question: How big is it, and is it heavy?
settings.answer: Dimensions are listed on the product page. It’s solid hardwood, so it has real weight to it — that’s the first thing people notice. Mounting hardware rated for the weight is included.

settings.question: How do I hang it?
settings.answer: It arrives ready to hang with keyhole mounts cut into the back and the hardware included. Most folks have it on the wall within five minutes of opening the box.

settings.question: Can I give it as a gift?
settings.answer: It’s one of the most popular retirement, Veterans Day, and Father’s Day gifts we know of. Add a note at checkout and we’ll include a handwritten card — no prices on anything.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept major credit cards, PayPal, Shop Pay, and Apple Pay for your convenience and security.

settings.question: How do I care for it?
settings.answer: Dust with a dry cloth — that’s it. The hand-rubbed finish protects it for decades. Keep it out of direct rain and it will outlive all of us.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: In-stock carvings ship within 1 business day, fully insured and free anywhere in the U.S. Most orders arrive in 3–5 business days. Made-to-order pieces show their build time on the product page.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: A 60-day money-back guarantee. If it doesn’t stop you in your tracks every time you walk past it, send it back for a full refund — we even cover the return shipping.
